data.desc: AirJoule Technologies Corporation (NASDAQ: AIRJ) is a water and cooling technology platform that seeks to free the world of its water and energy constraints. The company is commercializing its proprietary AirJoule technology for atmospheric water generation and dehumidification through a joint venture with GE Vernova. AirJoule Technologies also owns BitSink, a U.S. designer and manufacturer of modular data center infrastructure, liquid cooling systems and electrical equipment for AI and high-performance computing workloads.
